changes: Attempt to fix slow closing of the app on some devices.
Added a full-featured sleep timer with duration presets, end-of-track mode, pause or stop actions, an optional fade-out, and commands to cancel the timer or announce the remaining time.
Added full-screen video playback, multi-audio-track selection, and an audio-track dialog.
Added accessible subtitle reading for embedded subtitles, local subtitle files, and subtitle URLs, including options to remember a subtitle language and control whether new lines interrupt speech.
Added recent files, folders, and playlists, along with light, dark, and system theme choices.

Expanded YouTube browsing with video and audio quality preferences, audio-only playback, channel browsing, favorite toggling from search results, browser actions, and asynchronous loading that keeps the interface responsive.
Added YouTube video and audio downloads with saved defaults, custom per-download settings, direct downloads, and organized output folders.

Added a full YouTube download queue with concurrent downloads, per-item settings, background minimization, completion notifications, cancellation controls, and warnings before closing while downloads are active.
Added precise media selections with millisecond markers, multiple selection slots, repeat playback, a free playback slot, single-selection export, and multithreaded batch export to numbered files.
Reorganized YouTube preferences into expandable General and Download pages and improved preference loading performance.
Improved startup so the main window is shown and painted immediately while independent services initialize concurrently, with audio and MPV initialization prioritized.
Fixed file-name announcements for automatic navigation and for jumps by number, first, or last, and hardened selection playback so selection boundaries cannot accidentally advance the playlist.
Fixed Previous and Next navigation in long-running playlists and YouTube result sessions, including moving backward after starting from the final search result.
Fixed shuffle so the complete playlist is randomized once and keeps that stable order when files are added, closed, deleted, or moved.
Improved the IPTV channel browser by placing channel names in the first column.
Improved the portable updater so it no longer copies and launches itself from the Windows temporary folder. Portable updates now replace and recover the updater within the application folder.
Added SHA-256 integrity verification for application updates before the updater is started.
